title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify option (b) as the correct reason for the blue sky.

title: Understanding of Scattering
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of Rayleigh scattering and its role in the color of the sky.

title: Elimination of Incorrect Options
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why options (a) and (c) are incorrect.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be clearly articulated, showing logical reasoning.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that reflection from the sea or cobalt vapors cause the blue sky.
